title: Kerberoasting (Active Directory)
description: A single Samba Active Directory Domain Controller for MERIDIAN.LAB (Meridian Freight, a logistics company), no Windows VMs. The Transport Management System's database runs under a service account (svc-mssql-tms) that carries an MSSQL Service Principal Name and a weak RC4 key, so any domain user can request its Kerberos service ticket and crack it offline. From the foothold user t.okonkwo, roast svc-mssql-tms, recover its password, and read the flag from a share only that account may open.
question: Kerberoast the svc-mssql-tms service account, crack its Kerberos service ticket offline, and use the recovered password to read the flag from the //dc/manifests share.
